terms.gloss: a ridge, the crest of a hill
terms.comment: A yoke, and so the ridge that joins two heights.

terms.gloss: a crest (of an animal or a helmet), a cock’s comb

sources: Lewis & Short: jugum
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
